title: Field Studio Launch
description: Readings and discussion with Aisha Beliso-De Jesús, author of Excited Delirium: Race, Police Violence, and the Invention of a Disease; Bridget Guarasci, author of Warzone Ecology: The Violence of Planetary Repair in Iraq; Laurence Ralph, Sito: An American Teenager and the City that Failed him; Danilyn Rutherford, Beautiful Mystery: Living in a Wordless World; and Sophia Stamatopolou-Robbins, Waste Siege: The Life of Infrastructure in Palestine, along with Ro Skelton and Nomi Stone
